title: OrderIntentResult
description: ExecActivities.placeOrder / cancelOrder return type. The state field reflects the OrderIntentJournal row state after the activity ran; broker_order_id is set once the broker has accepted the order.

broker_order_id.description: Broker's order ID. Null when state is RECORDED (intent persisted but broker not yet called).

state.description: OrderIntentJournal row state. RECORDED→SUBMITTED on broker accept; SUBMITTED→CANCELLED on operator cancel; SUBMITTED→FILLED on broker fill; * →ERRORED on terminal failure.

last_error.description: Most recent broker / journal error message, if state==ERRORED or a transient failure was recorded.
